caption: This is my go to alternative to a pasta salad right now. The best fall salad!  Crispy Fried Gnocchi Pasta Salad Ingredients •  2 packs gnocchi •  1 large pack sweet peppers, 1 red onion, 1 pack cherry tomatoes (roasted at 425°F for 25 min) •  2 chicken breasts (seasoned, sautéed, chopped) •  ½ jar sun-dried tomatoes, diced •  1 cup Parmesan •  ¾ cup chopped basil •  1 cup Italian dressing Instructions 1.  Roast peppers, onion, and tomatoes at 425°F for 25 minutes. 2.  Season, sauté, and chop the chicken. 3.  Boil gnocchi until they float, drain, then pan-fry in oil until golden and crispy. 4.  Toss everything together with Parmesan, basil, and dressing. 5.  Serve warm or chilled.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
